facts.subject: pingIntervalSeconds
facts.note: Field default of BaseLoadBalancer; the config-driven path (initWithConfig, line 172) passes 30 instead.

facts.subject: maxTotalPingTimeSeconds
facts.note: Field default of BaseLoadBalancer; the config-driven path (initWithConfig, line 173) passes 2 instead. The files shown do not use this value to bound the ping loop (SerialPingStrategy, lines 890-918, has no time check).

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerPingInterval
facts.note: Default supplied at the call site clientConfig.get(key, 30); the key declaration itself (CommonClientConfigKey.java line 161) carries no default. Value is passed to setPingInterval, which sets pingIntervalSeconds (line 175, 327); unit seconds follows from pingIntervalSeconds * 1000 on line 275.

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerMaxTotalPingTime
facts.note: Default supplied at the call site clientConfig.get(key, 2); the key declaration (CommonClientConfigKey.java line 163) carries no default. Passed to setMaxTotalPingTime (line 176).

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerPingClassName
facts.note: With DummyPing, canSkipPing() (BaseLoadBalancer.java lines 256-263) is true and setupPingTask() returns without scheduling any ping (line 267-268), so no periodic liveness check runs by default.

facts.subject: NFLoadBalancerPingInterval
facts.note: The load balancer itself pings each server (line 682 pingerStrategy.pingServers, result from ping.isAlive at line 912) every pingIntervalSeconds (line 275) and sets liveness locally; these files name no broker coordinator, registry server or registry agent in this path. There is no per-server timeout key; maxTotalPingTime is not enforced in the shown code.

facts.subject: markServerDown
facts.note: markServerDown(Server) lets the caller of the load balancer mark a server dead immediately, without a timeout key.

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer.PingTask
facts.note: Ribbon has no heartbeat; the periodic ping is a TimerTask (line 634) scheduled on a ShutdownEnabledTimer (line 273) with its own daemon flag argument true, i.e. separate from request-handling threads. forceQuickPing() (line 817) instead runs the Pinger on the calling thread (line 824).

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer
facts.note: Emitted by the client-side load balancer at debug level (logger.debug) when a ping changes a server's alive state; the argument on line 697 is ALIVE or DEAD.

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer
facts.note: Emitted at error level (logger.error) when markServerDown marks a live server dead.

facts.subject: BaseLoadBalancer
facts.note: Registered listeners are called with the servers whose alive state changed; also called at line 778 from markServerDown.
